Prior to trips the hole should be circulated for at least bottoms up, this will often prevent tight hole on the way out and bridges, fill etc. on the way back in. Tight hole and/or washing and reaming on trips through new hole drilled are often feature of clay and shale drilling that

S at the shale shakers should be monitored for signs of cavings that may indicate need for an increased mud weight. Tight hole, fill on trips and torque or drag on connections can also be good early indications of the possible need to increase the mud weight to maintain stable hole conditions.
